p='/home/ubuntu/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/runs/adhoc-primeagentlearner-1792545471/attempts/cb5c46cb9eb34b0fb84b0c3660206bd3/system/state/workspace/programs/task-6e51a2b6.py'
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    sep_r = next((i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] in (1, 7)), None)
    sep_c = next((j for j in range(w) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1 and grid[0][j] in (0, 9)), None)
    if sep_r is not None:
        a, b = grid[:sep_r], grid[sep_r+1:]
        hh, ww = min(len(a), len(b)), w
    else:
        a = [row[:sep_c] for row in grid]
        b = [row[sep_c+1:] for row in grid]
        hh, ww = h, min(len(a[0]), len(b[0]))
    ca = set(v for row in a for v in row)
    cb = set(v for row in b for v in row)
    common = ca & cb
    c = next((x for x in common if sum(v == x for row in a for v in row) < sum(v == x for row in a for v in row) + 1), None)
    # The signal is the non-background color shared by both panels.
    c = next((x for x in common if x != 0), next(iter(common)))
    out = [[c for _ in range(ww)] for _ in range(hh)]
    for r in range(hh):
        for j in range(ww):
            if a[r][j] == c and b[r][j] == c:
                out[r][j] = 3
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
